question: Do isolated one-Compute starting-resource changes reduce the persistent Demis Hassabis and Elon Musk faction extremes without creating new faction or strategy dominance?
primaryComparisons: paired Demis and Elon winner and score deltas
faction win-share range by player count and homogeneous backend

selectionRule.imperialCandidate: Prefer 2 starting Compute if it materially compresses Demis at two through four players without pushing the faction below the competitive field at five or six.
selectionRule.verticalCandidate: Prefer 4 starting Compute if it materially improves Elon across player counts without creating a leading faction cell.
selectionRule.independence: Each candidate is compared only with canonical on common seeds. Either, both, or neither may be selected; no interaction claim is made until the selected combination receives a confirmation screen.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Neither arm establishes human counterplay, negotiation quality, duration, perceived fairness, or fun.
